facts.fact: The World Bank Program Paper says the additional financing will bring refugee learners into Ethiopia's national EMIS, with the Makatet roadmap envisioning their full integration, while the 57 refugee schools currently operate outside the Ministry of Education's EMIS.

HISP Ethiopia and the HISP Centre say Ethiopia has adopted DHIS2-Ed as its education management information system, with implementation starting with schools, woreda offices and zones in the SER, SWEPR, Oromia and Benishangul Gumuz regions.

The Ministry of Education's EMIS and ICT Executive Office published the Education Statistics Annual Abstract 2022/2023 (October 2023) and says the EMIS, available at decentralized levels, has been collecting and processing education performance data.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, EMIS and ICT Executive Office

facts.fact: The deal record says the US$69m World Bank additional financing includes full integration of refugee learners into the national EMIS and US$750,000 earmarked for EMIS enhancement and disaggregated reporting.

note: Document states only an e-invoice system launched for the Ministry of Revenues; no fact the study asks.

facts.fact: Education Minister Berhanu Nega says significant efforts have been made to digitalize education information systems including the EMIS and HEMIS, which are being strengthened to organize and connect data on students, teachers, institutions and outcomes.
